results.title: Romy and Magda Schneider: Mother - Daughter - Rivals?
results.original_title: Romy und Magda Schneider: Mutter - Tochter - Rivalinnen?
results.overview: New light is shed on the complex relationship between Romy Schneider and her mother Magda, a German film star of the 1930s admired by Hitler - who welcomed her and her daughter to his chalet in Berchtesgaden.

results.title: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club Final Chapter Part 2
results.original_title: ラブライブ！虹ヶ咲学園スクールアイドル同好会 完結編 第2章
results.overview: The second in the trilogy of Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai films that continues the story beyond season two and the OVA.

results.title: Pow!
results.overview: A Native American kid scrambles to charge his dying video game console at a bustling intertribal powwow.

results.title: Hollow Lake
results.overview: A relaxing weekend at their remote lake house appears to be the perfect remedy for stressed newlyweds Max and Baker. When Baker suggests that they use the getaway to finally pursue an illicit encounter he's been pressuring, Max reluctantly agrees, hoping it will add a much needed spark to their relationship. What results is an unimaginable blood soaked nightmare and will require unthinkable measures if they want to survive.

results.title: Untamable
results.overview: In Yaounde, Police Chief Billong is investigating the murder of a police officer. In the streets and at home, he struggles to maintain order. A man of principle and tradition, he is reaching breaking point.

results.title: Boonie Bears: Future Reborn
results.overview: Bramble, Briar, and Vick unexpectedly follow a time traveller 100 years in the future, where they find Earth beset by environmental catastrophe, with humanity barely able to survive.

results.title: Plight
results.overview: A grieving father and a Ukrainian immigrant form an unlikely partnership to seek justice after a hit and run changes their lives forever.

results.title: Lone Samurai
results.overview: A violent and reckless samurai is shipwrecked on a remote island left without an avenue for his rage. After undertaking a spiritual journey to appease his aggressive thoughts, he finds himself abducted by external demons taking the form of cannibals, putting his sense of reality and deadly talents to the test.

results.title: On Swift Horses
results.overview: Returning from the Korean War, Lee wants to begin a new life with his wife Muriel in California. But when his charismatic brother Julius arrives, their lives begin to change. Julius’s rebellious streak rubs off on Muriel, who secretly steps into the world of race horse gambling. Here she meets a new lover, a fellow woman looking to break free from her restrictive life. Meanwhile, Julius travels to Las Vegas, where he falls in love with a young man he meets at the card tables.

results.title: Being Eddie
results.overview: From teen comedian to Hollywood legend, Eddie Murphy revisits his extraordinary showbiz ride with raw honesty and humor.

results.title: Augmented
results.overview: AUGMENTED is an experimental non-fiction short, shot completely on 16mm, that analyzes the commonalities between medical augmentation and Transgender alignment. We are frightening because we're the future.

results.title: Pearlescent Fog
results.overview: In 1882, when Jelena Ilka Marković – the widow of Jevrem Marković, accused of participating in the Topolska Rebellion and summarily executed – attempted to assassinate King Milan Obrenović and thus avenge her husband. She was arrested, and a few months later she was found dead in her prison cell.

results.title: Vitória
results.overview: Nina is an elderly woman who lives alone and feels distressed by the increasing violence in her neighborhood. Amidst conflicts with her neighbors, she decides to film the movement of drug traffickers from her window, hoping to assist the police. After months of recording suspicious activities, her initiative attracts the attention of a journalist, who approaches Nina and offers to support her in her mission.

results.title: Maninilip
results.overview: Alex, a young photographer, secretly documents his neighbors’ sex lives. But when he witnesses Luisa being abused by her husband, he uses his camera to help her—and becomes entangled in a passionate affair.

results.title: Bad Man
results.overview: In Colt Lake, Tennessee, Sam Evans tackles a meth epidemic. He is side-lined on arrival of Bobby Gaines, an undercover agent. Despite Evans' local ties, Gaines is hailed as hero. Suspicions arise on Gaines which unravels a complex narrative.

results.title: Always Smile
results.overview: Two homeless brothers find themselves at the heart of an unexpected and dangerous journey when they witness a crime that shakes the foundations of the city’s corrupt underbelly. These resilient siblings discover the true meaning of family.
